YOUR CHANNEL, YOUR CHOICE

Connect to Twitch.

Scene Relay reads votes from your own channel. It cannot send chat messages or change your Twitch settings.

The public demo is preconfigured. Change this only for a different registered app. Never paste a password or client secret.

OAUTH REDIRECT URL FOR THIS HOST

Hosting elsewhere? Use your own Twitch app
  1. Use your own Twitch account with a verified email and two-factor authentication.
  2. In the Twitch developer console ↗, register an application with the exact redirect URL above.
  3. Replace the public Client ID here. No client secret is needed.
  4. Continue to Twitch and approve only user:read:chat.

Tokens stay only in this page’s memory. Reloading or disconnecting ends the local session. Practice data and chat identities are never saved or exported.

◉

One permission: read your chat.
Authorize only your own Twitch account. The public demo uses the registered Scene Relay app.

A SMALL, READ-ONLY TOOL

Your chat stays yours.

Scene Relay has no application server, analytics, paid AI calls or account database. After you connect, your browser communicates directly with Twitch to validate authorization and receive chat events.

Access tokens stay in page memory. Only temporary OAuth state and public configuration use session storage during the connection handoff. Raw chat text and viewer identities are not saved or exported. Votes use temporary viewer IDs in memory to prevent repeat counting; a new round resets them.

Practice votes are simulated and do not prove a Twitch integration. A real connection is always labelled separately. This app does not stream, send messages, moderate chat, or change OBS scenes; its own illustrated scene changes on screen.

The public demo uses the registered Scene Relay application. You authorize read-only access to your own channel. For a local or different host, register your own application with a verified email, 2FA and the correct callback URL. No Twitch subscription is required by this app.
